notes.title: 1 year since the release of Cast Cats
notes.content: [p]Kittens, today is a very special day![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been exactly [b]1 year since the release of Cast Cats[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This is the game into which I poured a piece of my soul, a flow of imagination, and a creative spark. A warm, cozy, and simple little spot-the-difference game designed to bring you comfort and relaxation.[/p][p]Over the past year, we’ve released several DLCs:[/p][list][*][p]A spooky pack for horror fans[/p][/*][*][p]A free Christmas update[/p][/*][*][p]Heroes & Villains content[/p][/*][*][p]And most recently — the final free DLC “Resort & Paws”, adding 15 brand-new summer beach levels![/p][/*][/list][p]That brings [b]the total to 130 levels in the game[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117350/6a9f3310792aa7157358fba5f7a964b8c0eb5a66.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the first anniversary, we’re launching a special sale:[/p][p][b]60%[/b] off the base game[/p][p][b]40%[/b] off the Horror Show DLC[/p][p][b]20%[/b] off the Heroes & Villains DLC[/p][p][/p][p]We invite you to try our creation and [b]share your thoughts in a review[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]And most importantly — thank you to everyone who has supported us since the very beginning! We regularly check your reviews, see your achievements, and follow the community activity. It’s heartwarming to know that people share screenshots, guides, illustrations, or simply ask questions. It means the world to us that Cast Cats has found its players. 💖[/p]

notes.title: Cast Cats - Resort & Paws DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[p]We’re happy to announce the release of the [b]final free DLC[/b] for [i]Cast Cats[/i]! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]This update brings:[/p][list][*][p]Brand-new summer-themed levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh music to match the season’s vibe[/p][/*][*][p]A cheerful farewell to summer with our sunny cats[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Cast Cats is a cozy spot-the-difference game where players compare two charming cat illustrations to uncover subtle differences. With this update, we wanted to close the summer season on a bright and playful note.[/p][p][/p][p]If you already own the game, the DLC is available now at no extra cost.
And if you haven’t tried Cast Cats yet, now is the perfect time to jump in — or simply support us with a wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457020/Cast_Cats__Resort__Paws_Pack"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cast Cats: Heroes & Villains Pack — our new superhero DLC is now available!
notes.content:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457030?utm_source=steamgroup]Cast Cats: Heroes & Villains Pack[/url][/b] — our new superhero expansion is [b]now available[/b]!

The number of cats is growing and the adventures are getting even more epic!
At last, the long-awaited superhero DLC for Cast Cats — [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457030?utm_source=steamgroup]Heroes & Villains Pack[/url] — is available for purchase! Brave furry fighters in masks and cloaks are ready to save the world... or at least a few cozy streets.
Or maybe cause some serious chaos instead?
It’s up to you! Sharpen your claws, practice your leaps, and choose your side.

Important: there’s only one boss achievement in the new expansion — due to Steam's limitations. But don’t worry!
To introduce you to all our fluffy heroes and villains, we’ve prepared a special illustration featuring their portraits and names.
Welcome to a world of shadows and shining stars! Meet them all:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3833013/f43ab98e0290a65fcb92f48c46d3e72dfc62c05d.png[/img]

And that’s not all!
Our first DLC, previously known as [b]the Halloween Pack, has been renamed to Horror Show Pack![/b]
Even more, we’ve added real rain to the update, creating a deeper, darker atmosphere.
Umbrellas? Who needs those when you’ve got fur and a fearless heart?

[b]Why the change?[/b]
It’s simple: we love horror! And not just on Halloween night — we love it on any ordinary evening when the darkness creeps in and mystery fills the air.
Horror Show Pack is no longer just a short Halloween event with pumpkins and lanterns — it's now a full-fledged Cat Horror Show, ready to spook and thrill any brave soul, any time of the year.

[b]Thank you for being with us![/b]
Your passion, warmth and support are the fuel for all our craziest and kindest ideas!

Stay tuned for our updates, chat about your favorite cats and share your adventures with us on social media which are listed below.

Stay fluffy and fabulous,
The Cast Cats Team

notes.title: Purrformance Boost + Super Cats Coming April 28!
notes.content:
Hello, kittens!
We have some news to share with you!

First of all:
A major update for Cast Cats has just been released! 

We’ve reworked the navigation system and redesigned the game’s start screen. Now you can jump straight into your favorite themed DLCs and easily switch between them! This change has allowed us to make the bottom interface — sleek and clean, just like a well-groomed kitty. 

Also, if you ever feel like heading back to the main menu, just click the logo of the game (or any DLC) — and boom! You're back at the start screen. Simple and smooth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117350/a3c5447e8d6bacda7856cbd95755094e90729320.jpg[/img]

Speaking of smoothness — we’ve removed unused materials to boost performance across the board. The game should now run more smoothly than ever. 

Some players were experiencing issues with screen resolution. This should now be resolved, if your problem still remains, either post in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3118450/discussions/]Discussion[/url] section of the Steam community or visit our [url=https://discord.werfestsoftware.com/]Discord server[/url]. We’re always here to help!


Well, secondly: We’re thrilled to announce that the Heroes and Villains Pack is almost here! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457030/Cast_Cats__Heroes_and_Villains_Pack/

April 28th is Superhero Day, and on that very day, our newest DLC will swoop into action! You'll be able to purchase all-new content featuring heroic and villainous kitties, with brand-new levels filled with action, drama, and adorable super-feats! 

We’ve poured tons of creativity into this pack, and we can’t wait for you to experience the epic tales of these meow-velous feline champions!

A quick note: due to Steam’s technical restrictions, we aren’t able to add multiple new achievements — but there will be one special achievement, which you’ll unlock after defeating the boss level in this add-on! 

Stay fluffy and fabulous,
The Cast Cats Team

notes.title: Let's Play!
notes.content:
We are happy to congratulate you (and ourselves) on the release of our game! Cat lovers can already launch Cast Cats and have fun looking at the beautiful kitties, finding the differences! 

Buy the game with 10% discount right now! We will be very happy if you rate the game and tell us what you liked or disliked). Which kitty has become your favorite?

If the community shows interest in Cast Cats, we'll do a themed update for you (and probably more than one), so we'd appreciate the feedback.
We love our project, and with it we give you a piece of our soul and love for cats!

If you have any difficulties or find a bug, please let us know via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3118450/discussions/0/4759829447828425619/]Discussion[/url].

Enjoy and meow!
